column1: # The 304 connectors returned by GET /api/workflow-builder/find-nodes-with-connections, out of
# 1,214 nodes. 24-hex appNames are custom (Connectors SDK) connectors and exist only on this
# tenant. Note the 25 rows with connections=0: find-nodes-with-connections lists them, but the
# Connection aggregation counts none - deleted or out-of-project connections. Trust the
# aggregation count, not the node list, when you need to know whether a connection is usable.
